blocks.text: Gateway Recovery Centre is a unique facility that was created to serve the unique needs of military personnel, veterans, first responders, and healthcare professionals who are seeking mental health and addiction treatment. The staff at Gateway Recovery Centre is made up of professionals with multidisciplinary backgrounds, including physicians, schizophrenics, nurses, counselors, and coaches. All staff members share a general ethos of empathy and compassion, and are always aware of the perspective of each client. At Gateway Recovery Centre, a comprehensive approach is taken to treat a range of co-occurring mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, and trauma, as well as alcoholism and behavioral addiction.

blocks.text: Clients at Gateway Recovery Centre will engage in a range of different treatment methods in order to address their unique needs. Some of these approaches include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), educational groups, family counseling, adventure therapy, life skills training, mindfulness meditation, yoga, and other activities. The goal of this comprehensive approach is to empower clients to address their individual challenges and lead a healthy and fulfilling life.

blocks.text: At Gateway Recovery Centre, we provide a range of personalized treatment programs to meet the unique needs of every individual. Our comprehensive programs include individual and group therapy, detoxification, mental health management, and relapse prevention strategies. centre.about_html:
About Gateway Recovery Centre

Gateway Recovery Centre is a unique facility that was created to serve the unique needs of military personnel, veterans, first responders, and healthcare professionals who are seeking mental health and addiction treatment. The staff at Gateway Recovery Centre is made up of professionals with multidisciplinary backgrounds, including physicians, schizophrenics, nurses, counselors, and coaches. All staff members share a general ethos of empathy and compassion, and are always aware of the perspective of each client. At Gateway Recovery Centre, a comprehensive approach is taken to treat a range of co-occurring mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, and trauma, as well as alcoholism and behavioral addiction.

Treatment Methods

Clients at Gateway Recovery Centre will engage in a range of different treatment methods in order to address their unique needs. Some of these approaches include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), educational groups, family counseling, adventure therapy, life skills training, mindfulness meditation, yoga, and other activities. The goal of this comprehensive approach is to empower clients to address their individual challenges and lead a healthy and fulfilling life.

Facilities

At Gateway Recovery Centre, clients can expect to find a pleasant and comfortable environment that is designed to promote healing and tranquility. The facility is located just outside of Peterborough, Ontario, on 14 wooded acres, next to the Heron Landing Golf Course. The building itself is 22,000 square feet, and features a range of amenities that contribute to the client’s overall experience. These include a lounge with a fireplace, semi-private rooms, a fully-stocked gym, a game room, and walking trails. Gateway Recovery Centre provides a therapeutic, peaceful setting that promotes healing and recovery.

Admissions Procedure

Gateway Recovery Centre has a quick and straightforward admissions procedure compared to non-private rehabilitation facilities. Clients at Gateway can expect compassionate staff who will work with them to make the process as seamless as possible. The admissions process is designed to get clients in and started on their journey as quickly and efficiently as possible. 




Gateway Recovery Centre - Center Overview

At Gateway Recovery Centre, we provide a range of personalized treatment programs to meet the unique needs of every individual. Our comprehensive programs include individual and group therapy, detoxification, mental health management, and relapse prevention strategies. In addition to these traditional treatment methods, we also offer alternative therapies such as art therapy, equine therapy, and outdoor activities to help clients find new and healthy ways to cope with their emotions and experiences.


Our experienced and compassionate staff understand that addiction and trauma are complex issues that require individualized care. They work closely with clients to develop customized treatment plans that address both the underlying causes of addiction and the physical and emotional symptoms of withdrawal. Our staff also provides ongoing support after treatment to help clients maintain their recovery and prevent relapse. At Gateway Recovery Centre, we are dedicated to helping individuals and their families overcome addiction and find a path to a fulfilling life in recovery.

Frequently Asked Questions About Gateway Recovery Centre

How long is the treatment program?

The length of the treatment program at Gateway Recovery Centre varies depending on the client’s individual needs.

Are clients able to see visitors during their stay?

Yes, clients at Gateway Recovery Centre are able to see visitors during their stay.

What types of activities are available to clients?

At Gateway Recovery Centre, clients can participate in a range of activities, including adventure therapy, life skills training, mindfulness meditation, yoga, and more.

Will clients receive individual counseling?

Yes, clients at Gateway Recovery Centre will receive individual counseling as part of their treatment program.

Is Gateway Recovery Centre licensed and accredited?

Yes, Gateway Recovery Centre is licensed and accredited and meets all of the requirements of the province of Ontario.

Can clients bring their own medications?

Yes, clients at Gateway Recovery Centre are allowed to bring their own medications, as long as they are approved by their physician.

What type of aftercare support is provided?

Gateway Recovery Centre provides a range of aftercare support options, including individual and group therapy, ongoing counseling, and support groups.

Does Gateway Recovery Centre offer any support for families?

Yes, Gateway Recovery Centre offers family counseling and support, in order to help clients and their families work through issues related to addiction and mental health.

About Gateway Recovery Centre

Gateway Recovery Centre is a unique facility that was created to serve the unique needs of military personnel, veterans, first responders, and healthcare professionals who are seeking mental health and addiction treatment. The staff at Gateway Recovery Centre is made up of professionals with multidisciplinary backgrounds, including physicians, schizophrenics, nurses, counselors, and coaches. All staff members share a general ethos of empathy and compassion, and are always aware of the perspective of each client. At Gateway Recovery Centre, a comprehensive approach is taken to treat a range of co-occurring mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, and trauma, as well as alcoholism and behavioral addiction.

Treatment Methods

Clients at Gateway Recovery Centre will engage in a range of different treatment methods in order to address their unique needs. Some of these approaches include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), educational groups, family counseling, adventure therapy, life skills training, mindfulness meditation, yoga, and other activities. The goal of this comprehensive approach is to empower clients to address their individual challenges and lead a healthy and fulfilling life.

Facilities

At Gateway Recovery Centre, clients can expect to find a pleasant and comfortable environment that is designed to promote healing and tranquility. The facility is located just outside of Peterborough, Ontario, on 14 wooded acres, next to the Heron Landing Golf Course. The building itself is 22,000 square feet, and features a range of amenities that contribute to the client’s overall experience. These include a lounge with a fireplace, semi-private rooms, a fully-stocked gym, a game room, and walking trails. Gateway Recovery Centre provides a therapeutic, peaceful setting that promotes healing and recovery.

Admissions Procedure

Gateway Recovery Centre has a quick and straightforward admissions procedure compared to non-private rehabilitation facilities. Clients at Gateway can expect compassionate staff who will work with them to make the process as seamless as possible. The admissions process is designed to get clients in and started on their journey as quickly and efficiently as possible. 




Gateway Recovery Centre - Center Overview

At Gateway Recovery Centre, we provide a range of personalized treatment programs to meet the unique needs of every individual. Our comprehensive programs include individual and group therapy, detoxification, mental health management, and relapse prevention strategies. In addition to these traditional treatment methods, we also offer alternative therapies such as art therapy, equine therapy, and outdoor activities to help clients find new and healthy ways to cope with their emotions and experiences.


Our experienced and compassionate staff understand that addiction and trauma are complex issues that require individualized care. They work closely with clients to develop customized treatment plans that address both the underlying causes of addiction and the physical and emotional symptoms of withdrawal. Our staff also provides ongoing support after treatment to help clients maintain their recovery and prevent relapse. At Gateway Recovery Centre, we are dedicated to helping individuals and their families overcome addiction and find a path to a fulfilling life in recovery.
